newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh trawler catches fire, sinks in Bay.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh trawler catches fire, sinks in Bay.

text.p: A Bangladeshi fishing trawler caught fire and sank in the Bay of Bengal on Sunday, and marine officials said all 20 sailors aboard were feared killed.
They said the mechanised trawler, owned by local fishing company, Sea Resources Limited, was on blaze on Sunday morning about 140 km (87 miles) from Chittagong port.
"The vessel sank around noon and all its 20 crew members were believed to have died," one official told reporters. He was unable to give futher details.
Port officials said they had asked all ships in the area to look out for survivors or bodies..
The cause of the fire was not immediately known.
